Exclusive Offers and Discounts for Study in China and Turkey

Discover our latest offers and discounted scholarships that we provide to our dear students.

China Offers Turkey Offers

Scholarships and Distinguished Opportunities in Chinese Universities

We offer you the latest government and university scholarship offers in China, which cover tuition fees, accommodation, and monthly stipend.

Full Scholarship

Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) - September 2025 Batch

Available Universities: Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

Majors: All available majors (Bachelor's, Master's, PhD)

Benefits: Full coverage of tuition fees, free university accommodation, monthly stipend (2500-3500 Chinese Yuan)

Requirements: GPA ≥ 80%, English (IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80) or Chinese (HSK 4)

Expiry: March 30, 2025

Limited seats available Apply Now
Partial Scholarship

Peking University Academic Excellence Scholarship

University: Peking University

Majors: Selected majors in humanities and natural sciences

Benefits: 50% discount on tuition fees, priority in university accommodation

Requirements: GPA ≥ 85%, two recommendation letters, strong study plan

Expiry: April 15, 2025

Competitive selection Learn More

Exclusive Discounts at Turkish Private Universities

Benefit from our special offers to get significant discounts on tuition fees at the best Turkish private universities.

75% Discount

75% Discount at Bahçeşehir University

University: Bahçeşehir University

Majors: Engineering, Business Administration, Fine Arts, Medicine (25% discount)

Benefits: 75% discount on tuition fees (except Medicine), 25% discount on Medicine

Requirements: High school certificate with good grades

Expiry: June 30, 2025

Popular programs Apply Now
60% Discount

60% Discount at Istanbul Aydın University

University: Istanbul Aydın University

Majors: All available majors (Bachelor's, Master's, PhD)

Benefits: 60% discount on tuition fees

Requirements: High school certificate with good grades

Expiry: July 15, 2025

Wide range of programs Learn More

Apply Now and Benefit from Our Limited Offers!

These offers are available for a limited time and for early applicants. Don't miss the opportunity!

Early Application Offer: Additional $500 Discount

Get an additional discount of $500 USD on our service fees when you complete your application before August 31, 2025.

Conditions:

Applies to all study programs in China and Turkey

Offer Expiry Date: August 31, 2025

Start Now

Frequently Asked Questions About Offers

Find answers to common questions about our scholarship and discount offers.

Yes, you can apply for more than one scholarship, but usually you will be accepted for only one scholarship.

Usually the basic documents are high school certificate, transcript, and passport photo.

Most offers are available for all nationalities, but please check the conditions of each offer individually.

Contact us to learn more about these offers and how to benefit from them.
